title: 31 Royal County Down Cres Markham Open House Video Tour
description:
Situated on a premium pie-shaped lot within the Kylemore community of Markham’s prestigious Angus Glen neighbourhood, welcome to 31 Royal County Down Crescent, a stunning 4 bedroom executive home with 4,050 sq. ft. of luxurious living space, and represented by DeClute Real Estate Brokerage.

Showcasing a beautiful open themed main level layout, off the entrance foyer is a formal living room with fireplace and pot lighting, and the formal dining room - both elegant entertaining spaces with columned entryways, high quality broadloom, as well as custom wall and ceiling moldings.

The custom moldings are found throughout the home, and the main level also showcases 9’ ceilings, hardwood flooring, and an abundance of natural light. Off the reception hallway are two coat closets and a well-appointed powder room featuring a custom vanity and designer wallpaper - as well as a graciously sized home office and den area finished with cozy broadloom.

With a soaring 18’ ceiling and open to the upper level, the family room also showcases columned entryways from the hallway and kitchen area, a gas fireplace, and oversized windows with north- and west-facing exposures.

The luxurious and equally functional kitchen space features a breakfast area with a walk-out to the backyard, and which enjoys the cozy warmth of a gas fireplace - while the gourmet custom kitchen showcases a huge pantry complementing the abundance of cabinetry, pot lighting, a large centre island, granite counter tops, and stainless steel appliances as well as a gas cooktop. A wonderful convenience while entertaining is a passageway from the kitchen to a butler’s servery off the dining room - and a few steps down from this hallway leads to another double closet as well as a laundry room with a side door entrance and direct access to the two car garage.

The upper level is finished with broadloom throughout, and features 8’ ceilings, four generously sized bedrooms filled with natural light, three washrooms, and a large double linen closet.

The first of these bedrooms is an ideal guest suite or second master bedroom, and comes with a double closet and its own 4-pc ensuite. The second and third bedrooms share a 5-pc Jack-and-Jill ensuite with double under mount basins in the vanity, and a private water closet with bath area. The master suite is a stunning and luxurious retreat, showcasing two walk-in closets; a spacious bedroom with sitting area; with designer light fixtures here, as well as in its spa-like 5-pc ensuite, which also showcases a separate glass shower area, double vanity with Corian counter, designer fixtures, soaker tub, and water closet.

This home also has an unspoiled lower level with 8’ ceilings and a washroom rough-in, and its pie-shaped lot has 59’ of frontage that widens to approximately 70’ in the backyard.

Just steps away from Angus Glen Golf Course, and a short walk to the Angus Glen Community Centre, this home is also within the highly sought-after catchment areas of Buttonville, Sir John A. Macdonald, and Sir Wilfred Laurier Public Schools, as well as Pierre Elliott Trudeau High School - one of the top ranked secondary schools in Ontario.

For more information, or to arrange a private viewing of this home, contact Audrey Larter of DeClute Real Estate Brokerage, at 416-686-9618.
author: Open House 24
